name: Imprint
description: Learns the tone colour of what it hears, holds it when Capture is switched off, and presses that colour on everything played after.

meters.name: Share of the Learn time heard

params.name: Capture
params.description: On, the effect listens and learns the colour of what it hears, starting afresh each time. Off, the colour it has learned is held.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Which colour is pressed on the sound. Captured is the one learned with Capture. The others are built in and always there.

params.name: Amount
params.description: How hard the colour is pressed on. The middle leaves the sound alone. To the right the colour is exaggerated, to the left it is turned inside out.

params.name: Shift
params.description: Slides the colour up or down the spectrum without changing the notes. Up makes the stamped body smaller and brighter, down larger and darker.

params.name: Replace
params.description: At zero the colour is laid over the sound's own. Turned up, the sound's own colour is flattened first, so different sounds come out with the same colour.

params.name: Smooth
params.description: How fine the colour is. Low keeps every bump, down to single partials of what was captured. High keeps only the broad colour.

params.name: Learn
params.description: How long a moment Capture remembers. Short takes the colour of the last instant. Long averages everything heard while it listens.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the untouched sound and the stamped one.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit and kit::Stft. A spectral envelope follower and a gain per bin, in the family of cross synthesis by envelope transfer; not a model of any product.
